prompt: What kind of repeat collection was the change at the end table intended to prevent?
promptZh: 收尾桌改用新做法，主要是為了防止哪種重複領取？

options.text: One person making a second claim under the same name at the end table
options.zh: 同一人在收尾桌用相同名字再領一次
options.whyZh: 舊做法已按個人名字核對；改查住址主要是要辨識名字不同但同住的人。

options.text: One household coming back to claim something again at the next swap
options.zh: 同一戶下次的交換活動又回來領取物品
options.whyZh: 目前限制的是同一天的重複領取；對話沒有說下一場會沿用本日的領取紀錄。

options.text: People from the same home collecting again by using the public shelf
options.zh: 同住的人改去公開架再拿一次
options.whyZh: 公開架依然對所有人開放；新做法只在收尾桌查核住址，不會阻止到公開架取物。

options.text: People from the same home collecting more than one share under different names
options.zh: 同住的人用不同名字領到不只一份
options.whyZh: 以前查的是個人名字，同戶多人可各領；現在按住址核對，這種重複較不容易發生。

evidence:
The swap is blind. The cups are wrapped. Last month we checked each person's name at the end table; two people from one family could each claim a cup.
The shelf is open to everyone. The end table checks by address now. It can take wrapped cups with a written condition tag; at the swap, notes stay inside the wrapping.
explanationZh: 以前查的是個人名字，同戶多人可各領；現在按住址核對，這種重複較不容易發生。

vocabulary.note: 這裡用住址找出可能同住的申領人，不是用來安排配送。
